name: Little Tree | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Sour Blue Watermelon
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Live Resin

Our Sour Blue Watermelon Live Resin Gummies are packed with punchy, mouthwatering flavor and 20MG of true-to-plant live resin per gummy. The result is a clean, energizing experience built for motion.

With a tart fruit finish and balanced effects, this gummy is made for music festivals, morning runs, and everything in between.

Whether you're out exploring or in your element—this gummy keeps the rhythm.
